title: Understanding the DataFrames
text: The images show two DataFrames: 'ticket' and 'jacket'. Each has a $$'passport_{id'}$$ column, which can be used to link the two DataFrames. Consider how you might use this information to filter or join data.

title: Filtering Modern Buildings
text: To determine if a building is modern, you need to calculate the proportion of rooms renovated in $$2003$$ or later. Think about how you can use a lambda function to filter buildings based on this condition.

title: Lambda Function Logic
text: Which lambda function correctly calculates the proportion of rooms renovated in $$2003$$ or later?
